utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Huntington Beach' by name among the cities in its service area.

value.name: Southern California Edison (SCE)
value.notes: Huntington Beach was formerly a member of the Orange County Power Authority (OCPA) CCA, but the City Council voted in May 2023 to withdraw; NEM/solar customers transitioned back to SCE bundled service in April 2024, with all remaining customers returning in June 2024. Confirmed directly via OCPA's own page: 'Southern California Edison (SCE) is once again your provider of both the electric generation and distribution service.' No CCA currently serves Huntington Beach.

county.notes: Huntington Beach is a well-documented Orange County city; also listed under Orange County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

permit_authority.value: City of Huntington Beach Community Development Department, Building & Inspection Division

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Huntington Beach/Orange County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

value.name: SolarAPP+ IREC training completion certificate ('How to Use SolarAPP+ For Rooftop Solar Projects', and the PV+Storage module for systems including batteries)
SolarAPP+ approval documents (downloaded after system submission)

value: Schedule inspection via the ACA Permit Center Portal (engage.huntingtonbeachca.gov/CitizenAccess)

value.notes: Applies to traditional (non-SolarAPP+) plan review. SolarAPP+ submissions receive instant permit approval for code-compliant systems.

value.program_or_pathway: SolarAPP+ (rooftop residential PV, up to 38.4 kW)
other_conditions: Main electrical service rated at maximum 400A, with service disconnects and busbars rated at maximum 225A
Homeowners may not self-file through SolarAPP+ unless they are themselves a licensed contractor
Energy storage (battery) systems require separate SolarAPP+ PV+Storage training/certification
